_ENEMY_FILE.notes: Separate 801-entry index file per enemy nation (same index entry format as c3.sg2, read from offset HEADER_SIZE=20680, no group table used). Direction d as for main-file walkers (0=NE..7=N). All 10 files must also contain native ids 201..448 (natives drawn with whatever enemy file is loaded; natives/barbarian art identical ids). Unused ids may be 1x1 transparent. Enemy pixel data (.555) must stay <= 2,400,000 bytes. NOT in enemy file: Caesar's legions (ENEMY_11_CAESAR -> FIGURE_ENEMY_CAESAR_LEGIONARY uses main GROUP_FIGURE_CAESAR_LEGIONARY + GROUP_BUILDING_FORT_LEGIONARY), revolting gladiators (FIGURE_ENEMY54_GLADIATOR uses GROUP_FIGURE_GLADIATOR). Enemy missiles (arrows/spears) use main GROUP_FIGURE_MISSILE. Enemy portraits in the figure info window use main GROUP_BIG_PEOPLE (window/building/figures.c:287). If an enemy figure type is spawned with a mismatched enemy_type, its image_id is simply not updated (functions return early).
